source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure of a neuron (PDF 27-28).

blocks.text: Neurons ki shakal mukhtalif hoti hai, magar sab ke teen bunyadi hisse hain: cell body, dendrites aur axon.

blocks.caption: Neuron ke hisse
rows: phaila hua hissa jis mein nucleus aur zyada tar organelles hain; is ke cytoplasm mein Nissl's granules, yaani ribosomes aur rough endoplasmic reticulum ke guchhe, hote hain

membrane wale phailao jo doosre cells se maloomat le kar impulses mein badalte aur cell body ki taraf le jate hain; motor aur inter-neurons, jo aik waqt mein kai jagah se lete hain, ke dendrites bohat shakhdar hote hain
lamba phailao jo impulses ko cell body se door le jata hai; neuron ka aik axon ya shakhdar axons ho sakte hain, aur is ka sira, axon terminal, muscle cell, gland cell ya doosre neuron se milta hai

blocks.alt: Neuron: shakhdar dendrites cell body ke gird jis mein nucleus hai, aur lamba axon jis par Schwann cells hain aur jo shakhdar axon terminals par khatam hota hai. Teer myelinated axon ke aik hisse ki bari tasveer tak jata hai: axon, us ke gird lipti myelin sheath (charbi ka ghilaf), Schwann cell ka nucleus aur do Schwann cells ke darmiyan node of Ranvier.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.1: Namoone ke neuron ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 15.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Dendrites, Nucleus, Cell body, Axon, Schwann cell, Axon terminals; bari tasveer mein Node of Ranvier, Nucleus of Schwann cell, Myelin sheath, Axon.

blocks.text: Neuroglia (glial cells) neurons ki madad karte hain: ghiza dete, fuzlaat hatate aur immunity dete hain. Do aham glial cells, Schwann cells aur oligodendrocytes, axons ke gird lipat kar kai membrane tahon wali myelin sheaths banate hain: Schwann cells peripheral nervous system mein aur oligodendrocytes central nervous system mein.

items: Myelin sheath aik insulating ghilaf hai jo axon par impulses ki raftar barhata hai.
Myelin sheath wale neurons myelinated aur baghair sheath wale non-myelinated kehlate hain.
CNS mein myelinated axons white matter, aur non-myelinated dendrites aur cell bodies grey matter banate hain. PNS mein myelinated aur non-myelinated axons gath kar nerves bante hain.
Myelin sheath har 1 se 2 mm par chhote khaali hisson, nodes of Ranvier, se toot'ti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Axons bohat lambe ho sakte hain: paon ke muscles ko chalane wale axons aik metre se zyada lambe hain, aur zarafe mein khopri se pelvis tak ke axons taqreeban teen metre lambe hain.

blocks.prompt: Dimagh mein myelin kaunse cells banate hain, aur baazu ki nerve mein kaunse?
blocks.explanation: Dimagh (CNS) mein oligodendrocytes; baazu ki nerve (PNS) mein Schwann cells.

items: Neuron: cell body (Nissl's granules), dendrites (andar ki taraf), axon (bahar, terminals tak).
Glia neurons ki madad karte; Schwann cells (PNS) aur oligodendrocytes (CNS) myelin banate; har 1 se 2 mm par nodes of Ranvier; white matter = myelinated axons.
